body:
At first, you are talking about fullscreen, right?

SFML uses XCB to find a suiting video mode for the user's requested mode. It then uses that mode's rotation setting when applying it. It might be possible that there are several modes with different rotation settings, but same width and height properties.

I will check this, thanks for reporting.

I did some research. The rotation setting is not part of the video mode at all, it's a setting for the X display. The latest master uses XCB for changing the resolution, but apparently that's broken at the moment (a fix is being prepared). However, with XCB we use the same rotation config that's being reported by XCB, so it theoretically should work with your system as well.

I will report back when the fullscreen issue is fixed. You can then build the latest SFML yourself and see if it fixes your problem. Earliest release that contains the fix will be 2.3, though.
Made a few updates to the code in my previous comment.  If it looks worthwile, I will submit a pull request.

issue.title: PNG files larger than 8bit?

repository.name: attract
repository.description: A graphical front-end for command line emulators that hides the underlying operating system and is intended to be controlled with a joystick or gamepad.

issue.body:
Every once in a while I get an error relating to a PNG file, for example;

Failed to load image "../vulgus_art/snap/exerion.png". Reason : PNG not supported: 8-bit only

It wouldn't be an issue if it was easy for me to track which ones cause this error, and edit them to be 8bit instead of 16 or 24 bit. There is just a few too many.
How easy would it be to allow loading of higher quality?

body: I see, however I wonder why xcb_set_screen_config() asks for a rotation as well. Like said, at first I have to fix the outstanding issues before we can continue on this. Your patch might help, though, so thanks in advance.
@LaurentGomila :) yep, ++ is not in my wheelhouse yet. Thanks for pointing that out.  _updated_

issue.title: Adjusted WindowImplX11.
issue.body:
- Replaced Xlib event names by XCB equivalents.
- Removed XCB_CW_OVERRIDE_REDIRECT in order to let the WM handle mapping the window to the full screen.
- Fixed mouse grabbing in fullscreen mode. Removed keyboard grabbing to allow the user to "alt+tab" out of the window.
- Completely revised fullscreen handling: The screen's resolution is not changed at all anymore. Instead the WM is asked for going fullscreen and the view is scaled.

body: @h0tw1r3 Please see #780, it should fix your issue.
Fullscreen is not what I'm going for.  Just need to get/set the current (effective?) desktop video mode / resolution.

@h0tw1r3: In #780 Tank rewrote how fullscreen switches are performed, but didn't touch the mode enumeration code or the code to retrieve the current (possibly rotated) mode. Perhaps you could consider submitting a PR containing your changes to VideoModeImpl.cpp, i.e. the first 2/3 of your diff?
